summary: Tested Point 44 (deferred parking coupon) in-process + via admin API and Point 43 (banner 3:1 no-crop) in the consumer app. New pytest suite: 9 tests, 8 pass / 1 fail. Point 43 verified PASS with a seeded 1200x400 banner (container aspect-ratio 3/1, img object-fit: contain, rendered box 366x122 = full 3:1, no side cropping). Point 44 core behaviour is correct (deferral on registration, issue-on-approve, idempotency, expiry clearing, no-op for non-parking users), but the coupon hook is missing from every approval path except admin /process and reprocess?wait=true — including the DEFAULT admin reprocess (background) and the WhatsApp/consumer-app auto-approve paths, which is how most parking-QR users will actually get their first bill verified.

critical.issue: Hook _maybe_issue_pending_parking_coupon is only called in _do_reprocess_bill_sync (?wait=true). The default background path (_do_reprocess_bill_bg, used by the admin UI) approves the bill but never issues the deferred parking coupon. Reproduced: test_reprocess_background_path_issues_coupon → 0 coupons after an 'approved' reprocess.

Auto-approved WhatsApp bills never call the hook, so a parking-QR user who uploads a bill on WhatsApp (the flow the welcome message tells them to use: 'Upload any purchase bill... your parking coupon QR will be sent') gets points but NO parking coupon. Same for the force-credit fallback branch.

critical.endpoint: routes/consumer.py bill upload (~line 1240, status set to 'approved')
critical.issue: Consumer-app bill upload sets status='approved' and credits points but does not call _maybe_issue_pending_parking_coupon — deferred coupon never issued for app uploads.

minor.issue: Dead/unreachable second `except Exception` block after `return coupon_code` inside the same try — remove (misleading, and flagged by linting as unreachable).

datetime.fromisoformat on a stored value without tz (legacy/manually-set docs) raises TypeError inside the inner try → silently swallowed and the coupon is then issued even though the window expired. Consider normalising to tz-aware.

Seeded banner image_urls point to a stale host https://brand-sync-staging.preview.emergentagent.com/banner-*.jpg which returns text/html (SPA index), so both production banners render the SafeImage text fallback instead of an image on the consumer Home. Point 43 could only be validated with a temporarily seeded banner.

issues: Live banner images are broken (bad seed URLs) so the banner area shows only the gradient + uppercase title fallback — looks like a rendering bug to a reviewer.

With object-fit: contain, any non-3:1 upload will letterbox against #1a1a2e which reads slightly off-palette against the cream home background; acceptable trade-off but consider matching --cp surface colour.

action_items: Call _maybe_issue_pending_parking_coupon from _do_reprocess_bill_bg (or better: from inside _reprocess_single_bill's approved return) so the default admin Reprocess and bulk reprocess also issue the coupon.
Call the hook on the WhatsApp auto-approve path in process_bill_image (bill_status == 'auto_approved', incl. force-credit fallback).
Call the hook on the consumer-app upload approval path in routes/consumer.py (status 'approved').
Delete the unreachable except block at server.py ~6058-6061.
Fix the stale banner image_url seeds (brand-sync-staging host returns HTML, not images).
critical_code_review_comments: Coupon issuance hook placement is fragmented: it is attached to two endpoints instead of a single choke point. Centralise it where a bill transitions to approved/auto_approved (one helper used by all 4 approval paths) to avoid this class of miss.
server.py is 9577 lines — Point 44 logic (registration + coupon issuance) belongs in a routes/parking module.
Idempotency via atomic $unset guard is correct and verified; keep this pattern if the hook is moved.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ITER74_ users/bills/coupons (deleted by module teardown, verified 0 leftovers) and a temporary TEST_ITER74_BANNER 1200x400 banner (removed after the UI check).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration74_point44_parking.py — it already contains a regression guard (test_reprocess_background_path_issues_coupon) that currently FAILS by design until the hook is added to _do_reprocess_bill_bg/_reprocess_single_bill. After the fix also add coverage for the WhatsApp auto-approve (process_bill_image) and consumer-app upload paths. Point 43 needs a real 3:1 banner seeded (helper_seed_i74_banner.py) because production banner URLs are broken.
rca_of_the_issue: Point 44's hook was wired only into process_bill (admin approve) and _do_reprocess_bill_sync. Since /api/bills/{id}/reprocess defaults to wait=false and delegates to _do_reprocess_bill_bg → _reprocess_single_bill (which returns action='approved' but has no hook), and since WhatsApp/consumer-app uploads auto-approve without going through process_bill, most real 'first verified bill' events never trigger coupon issuance, leaving parking_coupon_pending=true on the user indefinitely until the 60-day window silently clears it.
